oracle.ref: PR #1182 (fix); fix evidence: E2E 04/10/2026 J1.4: cowork.tracy.site/login and cowork.tracy.ai/login answered without strict-transport-security.
oracle.invariant: 'Tracy’s own https hostname answers with HSTS' is ok: /login, /auth/me and an unknown path on the TRACY_ORIGIN host carry strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000 (pre-fix: no such header anywhere). 'HSTS never names includeSubDomains or preload' is ok. 'a customer site’s hostname and a customer’s own domain never get HSTS' is ok. 'a laptop stand on http never gets HSTS' is ok. 'an answer relayed straight from fetch (immutable headers) still carries HSTS on Tracy’s host' is ok, and the same relay on a customer hostname is left untouched.
